selected_evidence.requirement: Persist C.UTF-8 as the system default locale
selected_evidence.summary: Shows LANG=C.UTF-8 in /etc/locale.conf, the /etc/default/locale compatibility link, PID 1's locale, and UTF-8 character mapping before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Apply C.UTF-8 to new login sessions and services
selected_evidence.summary: Direct runtime tests show both a clean PAM login and newly launched systemd service receive LANG=C.UTF-8 and report UTF-8.

Captures healthy task-specific baseline with boot ID 6ace821e-74bc-4ff3-87f2-ddd87860ca43, native reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 7013789f-cfbd-4c2a-9e29-79a754b6e40b, active login manager, persistent configuration, and recovered login/service locale behavior.
